source_admission: Published values used as constants or quoted ranges in people.py and people_and_land.md; no external dataset files are admitted. 'access' records how far each source was checked on 2026-10-09: 'full text' means the passage was read in the source or its accepted manuscript; 'abstract' means the abstract or landing page; 'reported via search summary' means a search result or a secondary report only. Entries 'reported in' another sources file were read by that file's search and not re-read here. Bibliographic details are as found.
